items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: as Hal Singer said, he loved me, he says I got him where he could be seen.

ctx.x: they went on before. They were later. And I'll tell you the truth, you see when they begin to talk about my band, as Hal Singer said, he loved me, he says I got him where he could be seen. Don Robert (phonetic spelling) said it meant so much in developing musicians, you know, that promoter in Houston, well I played Denison, Texas and that was his home at one time, he happened to be in Denison on some business--
